title: Bookkeeping software for Dutch holding companies compared
content_html:
This bookkeeping software for Dutch holding companies comparison covers four options. Exact Online suits groups that want finance, ERP, CRM and HR in one cloud package. Moneybird and e-Boekhouden.nl are Dutch online bookkeeping programs with automatic invoice processing and tax links. Bookwise, from Upward Technologies, is bookkeeping software built for Dutch BV groups.

A BV (besloten vennootschap) is a Dutch private limited company. A holding structure usually means more than one BV, so the questions that matter go beyond what a single company needs. The facts about each competitor below come from its own website, as read in November 2026.

Bookkeeping software for Dutch holding companies comparison at a glance

ProductWhat its website says it isWho it says it is for
Exact OnlineCloud-based SaaS (software as a service) with Accounting and ERP capabilities, covering Finance, ERP, CRM and HRSMEs (small and medium-sized enterprises) and accountants
MoneybirdOne package for all of an entrepreneur's financial mattersFrom self-employed starters (zzp'ers) to growing BVs
e-Boekhouden.nlDutch online accounting program with invoicing, VAT returns and links to banks and the Belastingdienst (the Dutch tax authority)Entrepreneurs, accountants and associations or foundations
BookwiseBookkeeping for Dutch BV groupsDutch BV groups

Exact Online

Exact describes itself as a Dutch technology company that builds cloud-based accounting, ERP and business management software for SMEs and accountants. According to its website, Exact Online covers Finance, ERP, CRM and HR in one solution.

Its genuine strength is breadth. The website says AI agents and the Exact AI Assistant come standard, including a Bank Agent, a Purchase Agent and a Debtor Agent. It also says Exact Online can be extended with business apps and documented API (application programming interface) integrations, with a choice of more than 220 industry-specific apps. Exact Online gets monthly releases, and Exact offers Tax and Annual Reporting editions for accounting firms.

Pick it if your holding wants bookkeeping, ERP, CRM and HR in one cloud package, or your group works in one of the industries Exact lists, such as wholesale, manufacturing, construction or hospitality. Source: exact.com/products.

Moneybird

Moneybird describes itself as an accounting package where all of your financial matters come together in one place. Its pricing page says it adapts to your business, whether you are just starting as a zzp'er or have a growing BV.

Its genuine strength is taking routine bookkeeping work away. According to its website, Moneybird calculates VAT automatically from your invoices and receipts. It recognises the amount, VAT and supplier on purchase invoices and books most invoices itself. You can link an existing business account at almost any Dutch bank, send invoices through the Peppol network and put iDEAL or credit card payment options on your invoices.

Pick it if you want a Dutch bookkeeping package with strong invoice and VAT automation and wide Dutch bank support. Source: moneybird.nl/functies.

e-Boekhouden

e-Boekhouden.nl describes itself as a Dutch online accounting program for entrepreneurs, accountants and associations or foundations. Its feature list covers bookkeeping, invoicing, quotes, time tracking, customer management, inventory management and more.

Its genuine strength is its direct link to the tax authority. The website states it is recognised by the Belastingdienst and has a direct connection for submitting VAT returns. Its Autopilot feature processes purchase invoices and receipts automatically as entries in your bookkeeping. You can connect your bank, webshop or cash register system, and the feature list includes an API and a mobile app. For accounting firms, the website offers one environment to manage all client administrations.

Pick it if you want a Dutch online program with direct VAT filing and a broad set of features in one place. Source: e-boekhouden.nl.

Bookwise

Bookwise is bookkeeping software for Dutch BV groups, made by Upward Technologies (upwardtech.nl), a software company in Breda. It is a separate product, sold and used on its own. It is not part of any custom software project and you do not need to hire Upward Technologies for anything else to use it.

The difference from the three products above is focus. Exact Online, Moneybird and e-Boekhouden.nl serve a wide range of businesses. Bookwise is aimed at one situation: a group of Dutch BVs. Ask Upward Technologies directly how Bookwise handles the parts of your group's bookkeeping that matter most to you.

Pick it if your bookkeeping questions are mostly about running a group of BVs, and you want a product that starts from that situation.

When none of these fit

Some holdings have a process that no package follows well. In that case Upward Technologies also builds custom software. A project starts with a three-week paid scoping phase that ends with a document you could take to another supplier and a go or no-go decision. Read more in this guide to choosing custom software development. If a package does the job, a package is the better choice.

How we compared

We looked at each product against the questions a Dutch holding company is likely to face:

  • Fit for a group of BVs. Ask each vendor how it handles several administrations, bookings between your own companies and reporting across the group.
  • Dutch tax and bank links. Check how VAT returns are prepared and filed and which banks connect.
  • Invoice processing. See how much of purchase invoice handling the product does by itself.
  • Room to grow. Check whether the product offers an API or app integrations if your group needs other systems later.
  • Breadth or focus. Decide whether you want one package for finance, ERP and HR, or a product focused on bookkeeping.

We did not compare prices. Check each vendor's current pricing on its own website. For a broader look at the same category, see our guide to the best bookkeeping software for Dutch holding companies.
